prompt: Help me write a commit message for this change: removed all the old REST endpoint handlers from account-service now that gRPC migration is complete, deleted the OpenAPI spec files that were only used internally, and updated the CI pipeline to stop generating REST client stubs.

```
Remove account-service REST layer after gRPC migration

Drop all REST endpoint handlers, delete internal OpenAPI specs, and
remove REST client stub generation from CI. gRPC migration is complete
and no external consumers remain on the old endpoints.
```

```
Drop account-service REST layer now that gRPC migration is complete
```
